notes: Fletcher mistakes falling white blossoms for snow, so both 'blossoms' and 'snow' are central vocabulary items and the contrast between them is thematically important. 'White' is included as a colour descriptor because the visual similarity of blossoms to snow is the core story concept — useful for students to express same/different comparisons. Several words (fox, bird, rabbit, meadow, snow) are already present in the existing activity_images or aac_extras pool and can be reused directly. 'Spring' and 'blossoms' are the highest-priority new additions. 'Wind' is picturable and drives the plot (wind blows the petals). The fixed core row already contains 'colour', 'same', and 'different', which pair well with this book's themes.
